title: The scale, Islam and Iman
summary: How Hazrat describes the weighing of deeds on the Day of Gathering, being with the one you love, and the difference between Islam and Iman.

blocks.p: In a short dars on the journey of the soul, Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. describes what happens after this world ends, and then explains the difference between Islam and Iman.

When the world comes to an end, he says, we are brought to the plain of Hashr. There we are presented as souls, not bodies, but the form stays the same as in this world. Questions are asked, answers given, and deeds are weighed.

blocks.q: First: bring the fard prayers. Did you pray? Yes, I did. Bring your prayers. So many prayers. Put them on the scale. What is the weight? Not yet enough for Paradise.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 6:17

blocks.p: Then the sunnah prayers are added, and the weight is better, but still not enough. Then the nafl prayers and the night prayer, tahajjud, are added, and the weight grows. Then, Hazrat says, the Prophet ﷺ recommended that the person be sent to Paradise.

blocks.q: You will be with the one you love. The Prophet ﷺ said this.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 7:33

blocks.p: Hazrat says that those who loved the Prophet ﷺ and were devoted to him are all there, and that even if such a person had been sent to the Fire, the Prophet ﷺ would have taken him out. 'So this is how we must live,' he says. 'It is Allah's grace. If Allah wills, we will be forgiven.'
Hazrat says whoever comes to the masjid, you must testify that he is a Muslim. Then he explains that being a Muslim is a great thing, and being a believer is greater still.

blocks.q: Islam is related to Allah, and faith to the Prophet ﷺ. What is Islam? La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasulullah. And what is faith? More than my own life, the Prophet ﷺ is dear to me.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 8:34

blocks.q: My life is a sacrifice for the Prophet ﷺ. My children, my family, my wealth, all of it a sacrifice for the Prophet ﷺ. This is faith.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 8:52

blocks.p: The same teaching, that a person is with the one he loves, comes again in the dars on Bai'at, where Hazrat applies it to the murid and his shaykh.

blocks.note: Hazrat describes the weighing in story form in this dars. For anything beyond what he says here, ask your teacher.

sources.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida

ru.title: Meezaan, Islam aur Imaan
ru.summary: Hazrat Hashr ke din aamaal ke tole jaane ko, jis se mohabbat ho uske saath hone ko, aur Islam aur Imaan ke farq ko kaise bayaan karte hain.

blocks.p: Rooh ke safar par ek chhote dars mein Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. bayaan karte hain ke is duniya ke khatam hone ke baad kya hota hai, aur phir Islam aur Imaan ka farq samjhaate hain.

Jab duniya khatam hogi, woh farmate hain, humein maidaan-e-Hashr mein laaya jaayega. Wahaan hum roohon ki shakl mein pesh honge, jismon ki nahin, lekin soorat wahi rahegi jo is duniya mein thi. Sawaal kiye jaayenge, jawaab diye jaayenge, aur aamaal tole jaayenge.

blocks.q: Pehle: farz namazein laao. Namaz padhi? Haan, padhi. Apni namazein laao. Itni namazein. Meezaan par rakho. Wazan kitna hai? Abhi Jannat ke liye kaafi nahin.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 6:17

blocks.p: Phir sunnat namazein milaayi jaati hain, aur wazan behtar hota hai, lekin phir bhi kaafi nahin. Phir nafl namazein aur raat ki namaz, tahajjud, milaayi jaati hain, aur wazan badhta hai. Phir, Hazrat farmate hain, Huzoor ﷺ ne sifaarish ki ke is shakhs ko Jannat mein bheja jaaye.

blocks.h: Jis se mohabbat ho uske saath

blocks.q: Tum usi ke saath hoge jis se tum mohabbat karte ho. Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh farmaya.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 7:33

blocks.p: Hazrat farmate hain ke jo log Huzoor ﷺ se mohabbat karte the aur unke deewaane the woh sab wahaan hain, aur agar aisa shakhs Jahannam mein bhej bhi diya gaya hota to Huzoor ﷺ usko nikaal lete. 'To humko aise hi jeena hai,' woh farmate hain. 'Yeh Allah ka fazl hai. Allah chahe to hum bakhsh diye jaayenge.'
Hazrat farmate hain ke jo bhi masjid aata hai, aapko gawaahi deni hai ke woh Musalmaan hai. Phir samjhaate hain ke Musalmaan hona badi baat hai, aur momin hona us se bhi badi.

blocks.q: Islam ka ta'alluq Allah se hai, aur imaan ka Huzoor ﷺ se. Islam kya hai? La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasulullah. Aur imaan kya hai? Apni jaan se zyaada Huzoor ﷺ mujhe pyaare hain.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 8:34

blocks.q: Meri jaan Huzoor ﷺ par qurbaan. Mere bachche, mera khaandaan, mera maal, sab Huzoor ﷺ par qurbaan. Yahi imaan hai.

src.label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 8:52

blocks.p: Yahi ta'leem, ke aadmi usi ke saath hai jis se woh mohabbat karta hai, Bai'at ke dars mein dobara aati hai, jahaan Hazrat isko murid aur uske shaykh par laagu karte hain.

blocks.note: Is dars mein Hazrat aamaal ke tolne ko qisse ki shakl mein bayaan karte hain. Jo kuch unke farmaane se aage ho, uske liye apne ustaad se poochiye.
